scripts.install:all: npm --prefix allgym-backend install && npm --prefix allgym-frontend install
scripts.docker:up: docker compose -f allgym-backend/docker-compose.yml up -d db redis
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run docker:up && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix allgym-backend run dev" "npm --prefix allgym-frontend run dev"
